faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Residential Schools Chatra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the offline application for the Residential Schools Chatra Part-time Bell-based Teacher posts is 06 September 2026. Ensure your application reaches the concerned authority before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Part-time Bell-based Teacher posts?
faq.answer: There are a total of 26 vacancies announced for the Part-time Bell-based Teacher positions across various subjects and primary levels in Residential Schools Chatra.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for these posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualification varies by post. For Teachers (Classes 6-10), PG/Graduate with B.Ed or a relevant teacher training degree is required. For Primary Teachers (Classes 1-5), a Graduate degree with B.Ed or a teacher training degree is necessary.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the applicants?
faq.answer: The minimum age requirement is 21 years, and the maximum age limit is 40 years. Age relaxation will be provided as per the rules of the Jharkhand Government.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Part-time Bell-based Teacher positions?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be paid Rs. 200 per hour for their services as Part-time Bell-based Teachers.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment drive. The application process is free of cost.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application process for the Residential Schools Chatra Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or as instructed in the notification.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Part-time Bell-based Teacher posts will primarily involve the preparation of a Merit List followed by Document Verification.

faq.question: Q9. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of Residential Schools Chatra, which is chatra.nic.in. Links are also provided in the 'Important Links' section of this article.

faq.question: Q10. What documents are required to be attached with the application form?
faq.answer: Candidates are required to attach self-attested copies of necessary documents, including a photograph, signature, ID proof, and relevant educational and training certificates, along with the duly filled application form.
